mapper.sql: n.noti_id, n.rcvr_user_id, n.noti_type_cd, n.noti_cn, n.link_scrn_id, n.link_key, n.read_yn, n.noti_dttm, n.read_dttm
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_SY_USER u WHERE u.user_id=#{actor} AND u.user_stat_cd='USE' AND u.temp_pwd_yn='N')
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_SY_USER u WHERE u.user_id=#{actor} AND u.user_stat_cd='USE')
SELECT u.reg_user_id FROM TB_SY_UPLD u WHERE u.upld_id::text=#{id}
SELECT u.warn_cnt::integer FROM TB_SY_UPLD u WHERE u.upld_id::text=#{id} AND u.reg_user_id=#{actor} AND u.aply_dttm IS NOT NULL
SELECT FROM TB_SY_NOTI n WHERE n.noti_id=#{notificationId} AND n.noti_dttm >= #{cutoff} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM TB_SY_NOTI n WHERE n.noti_id=#{notificationId} AND n.rcvr_user_id=#{actor}

WITH roles AS ( SELECT r.role_id, r.data_scope_cd FROM TB_SY_ROLE r JOIN TB_SY_USER_ROLE ur ON ur.role_id=r.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{actor} AND r.use_yn='Y' ), parts AS ( SELECT s.part_id FROM TB_BS_PART_STD s WHERE s.part_ldr_user_id=#{actor} AND s.aply_bgn_ym <= to_char(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul','YYYYMM') AND (s.aply_end_ym IS NULL OR s.aply_end_ym >= to_char(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul','YYYYMM')) UNION SELECT s.part_id FROM TB_SY_USER_SCOPE s JOIN TB_BS_PART p ON p.part_id=s.part_id WHERE s.user_id=#{actor} AND s.scope_type_cd='PART' AND p.hq_yn='Y' AND p.use_yn='Y' ), targets AS ( SELECT b.proj_id, NULL::varchar AS part_id FROM TB_BL_BILL b WHERE #{notification.type}='DUN' AND b.bill_id=#{notification.targetKey} UNION ALL
SELECT a.proj_id, NULL::varchar AS part_id FROM TB_PJ_ASGN a WHERE #{notification.type}='WTHDR' AND (a.asgn_id=#{notification.targetKey} OR (#{notification.targetKey} ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' AND a.asgn_stat_cd='ACT' AND a.input_end_dt=to_date(#{notification.targetKey},'YYYY-MM-DD'))) UNION ALL SELECT o.proj_id, o.part_id FROM TB_SL_OPP o WHERE #{notification.type}='QUOTE_REJ' AND o.opp_id=#{notification.targetKey} ), target_parts AS ( SELECT t.part_id FROM targets t WHERE t.part_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT pp.part_id FROM targets t JOIN TB_PJ_PROJ_PART pp ON pp.proj_id=t.proj_id WHERE pp.aply_bgn_ym=(SELECT max(p2.aply_bgn_ym) FROM TB_PJ_PROJ_PART p2 WHERE p2.proj_id=pp.proj_id AND p2.aply_bgn_ym <= to_char(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul','YYYYMM')) ) SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_SY_MENU m JOIN TB_SY_ROLE_MENU_AUTH a ON a.menu_id=m.menu_id JOIN roles r ON r.role_id=a.role_id WHERE m.scrn_id=#{notification.screenId} AND m.use_yn='Y' AND a.inq_yn='Y') AS read_allowed, (#{notification.type}='CASH_SHORT' OR (#{notification.type}='UPLD_DONE' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_SY_UPLD u WHERE u.upld_id::text=#{notification.targetKey} AND u.reg_user_id=#{actor})) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM roles r WHERE r.data_scope_cd='ALL') OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM roles r WHERE r.data_scope_cd='PART') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM parts p JOIN target_parts t ON t.part_id=p.part_id)) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM roles r WHERE r.data_scope_cd='PROJ') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_SY_USER_SCOPE s JOIN targets t ON t.proj_id=s.proj_id WHERE s.user_id=#{actor} AND s.scope_type_cd='PROJ'))) AS in_scope, (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM targets) OR (#{notification.type}='CASH_SHORT' AND #{notification.targetKey} ~ '^[0-9]{6}$') OR (#{notification.type}='UPLD_DONE' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_SY_UPLD u WHERE u.upld_id::text=#{notification.targetKey} AND u.reg_user_id=#{actor}))) AS target_exists, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_SY_MENU m WHERE m.scrn_id=#{notification.screenId} AND m.use_yn='Y' AND m.pc_only_yn='Y') AS pc_only
